alice: Heads-up — saw a customer report where a streamed request got preempted, retried on fallback, and ended up double-billed for a tool call that was truncated on the first attempt. ben: ugh. do we have traces/ids for that session? alice: yes — session_id=si_9X2 and router_trace=rt-44f. attached logs show a preempt because of capacity preemption -> retry to cheaper model -> cheaper model returned shorter chunk and we issued a tool call; then reconnect replay sent the tail chunk which included same tool call suffix. clara: can you paste the minimal logs? alice: ```
[INFO] 2026-02-14T18:42:11Z router: preempted request si_9X2 -> fallback route r:cheap-eu
[INFO] 2026-02-14T18:42:11Z runtime: stream truncated by model (max_tokens_reached)
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T18:42:11Z toolcall: CALL tool_search(q=... ) id=tc_77 suffix_index=5 provisional=true
[INFO] 2026-02-14T18:42:12Z client: reconnect session si_9X2 -> route r:primary-eu
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T18:42:12Z replay: resend chunk suffix_index=5 includes toolcall id=tc_77 provisional=false
``` ben: So provisional=true on cheaper route, then replay arrived and was treated as confirmed and we charged again? alice: Exactly. Console shows provisional credit but ledger moved to confirmed when replay landed -> double charge. dan: Did we dedupe by toolcall id? seems tc_77 should've been used to dedupe. clara: Our current dedupe window only applies per-router-session and per-model-variant. Since the retry came via a different route, dedupe missed. ben: Right, routing preemption breaks our dedupe scope. We either need global toolcall id dedupe or attach a canonical session GUID that survives route switches. dan: Also truncation complicates things because the cheaper model cut the stream before we had a full call confirmation; we mark provisional then confirmed later. The tricky bit is provisional ledger semantics across routes. alice: Customer impact: they saw an extra ~0.5k tokens billed. They filed a ticket and asked for console visibility. clara: Short-term mitigation ideas: (1) stop converting provisional->confirmed if origin_route != confirming_route, keep provisional until TTL expires; (2) expand dedupe key to include toolcall.id globally; (3) attach client-provided idempotency key. ben: (1) avoids immediate double-confirmation but risks leaving provisional forever if confirm never arrives. Need TTL and reconciler. dan: (2) global dedupe seems safest but we need to check storage/lookup perf at scale. Could be a small LRU cache keyed by toolcall id -> confirmed_count. clara: (3) asking SDKs/clients to provide idempotency keys helps but non-guaranteed for older clients. alice: From telemetry: this pattern appears ~0.02% of streaming sessions during high preemption windows. Not huge, but visible in support. ben: UX ask: console should show provisional vs confirmed per-token breakdown and indicate when provisional crossed models/routes. Reporting needs a column for origin_route. dan: For immediate patch: implement route-aware confirmation gating: require confirmation route == origin route OR explicit reconciler check to avoid blind confirm. Also add a fast-path dedupe lookup for toolcall ids in the router. clara: I'll take prototype for dedupe cache (LRU memcache + fallback to ledger lookup). Need ~2 weeks. alice: I'll file a concise post to support with instructions and a manual refund script until fix ships. ben: I'll add a small dashboard tile: "provisional->confirmed mismatches by route" and alert if > 0.1% of provisional credits flip within 60s. dan: Can we add a replay marker to streaming chunks so runtime can drop duplicates earlier? small change: include last_toolcall_ids in session handshake. clara: Good idea. We'll scope handshake change as non-breaking: router will forward last_toolcall_ids in X-Resume-Ids header. alice: Action items: clara=dedupe cache prototype, ben=dashboard alert + console column, dan=protocol header + router guard, alice=support note + refund script. ben: thx. @billing-bot can you tag the relevant billing folks so we can run a one-off reconciliation? :pray: billing-bot: pinging @billing-team — saw provisional/confirm flips on si_9X2, pls advise on refund window policy. billing-bot: (reaction) :eyes: clara: I'll PR a spec for the global dedupe and route-gating today. short note there will be a small perf cost for the dedupe cache but we think it's acceptable. dan: Cool. If we decide global dedupe, we should also add a nightly job to sweep orphan provisional credits and reconcile with actual confirmed charges. alice: ok locking this for now. thanks all — going to update the ticket with patch ETA. :memo:
